state: Cases — Gotowe do startu with resolver-backed readiness and real start action

ready_case.title: FRT035 Ready 1788109000000
ready_case.lifecycle: ready_to_start, started through the list action, then deleted through the existing UI flow

ready_filter_and_counter.result: Authenticated production showed Gotowe with value 1 and rendered the synthetic ready case in the filtered list. After the start transition the same counter returned to 0.

resolver_backed_readiness.result: The shared case lifecycle resolver derives the visible bucket and attention state from the real case source; persisted completeness is used only as a bounded fallback when checklist items are unavailable, while loaded item data remains stronger truth.

start_action.result: The ready row exposed the accessible action Rozpocznij realizację sprawy FRT035 Ready 1788109000000 and the visible label Rozpocznij realizację, alongside Otwórz sprawę.

start_transition.result: Clicking the real list action changed the case to W realizacji, removed it from Gotowe, preserved the open-case count and displayed the user-facing toast Realizacja sprawy rozpoczęta.

case_cleanup.result: The synthetic started case was removed through the existing confirmation flow; the open-case count returned to 1 and only the retained FRT032 waiting case remained.

waiting_regression.result: The retained FRT032 case remained Czeka na klienta and was not converted into ready or blocked state by the FRT-035 transition.

brand_and_copy.result: The authenticated shell displayed CloseFlow and CF. No Forteca name or Vercel hostname appeared in user-facing application copy.

preview_boundary.result: The deployed preview loaded successfully and redirected to the application login because the in-app browser session is scoped to closeflowapp.vercel.app. Deployment readiness is verified; authenticated preview mutation proof is not claimed.

source_of_truth.note: Readiness, visible attention and status transitions use one runtime chain; evidence and workflow records document that chain but do not store a competing product state.

safety_proof.retention_reason: The earlier FRT032 waiting fixture remains available for the waiting-state regression and later stages.

browser_diagnostic_boundary.finding: The approved in-app browser was used for visible DOM and action verification; no standalone browser, raw CDP or session extraction was used.
browser_diagnostic_boundary.interpretation: Production readiness filtering, lifecycle start, toast, cleanup, retained waiting state and visible brand were verified through the live Vercel UI. Preview deployment and public login boundary were verified separately.
